description: Manitoba Highway Inventory is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. An accurate depiction of road structure construction history of the Highway Network in Manitoba. Manitoba Infrastructure -- Highway Engineering-- Highway Planning and Design (HPD) manages the Highway Inventory System (HIS). This system tracks road structure and construction history of Manitoba's Road Network. Coverage: Government of Manitoba. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Its tags are Highway, Inventory, Highway Inventory System, HIS, Road Network. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OpenMB Information and Data Use License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
